name: tasks
description: Delegate, track, receive and complete tasks—the flow of work between agents. Load when assigning work, coordinating a pipeline, or handling your own queue.

content.inline:
## Tasks
A delegated task is a tracked Job; its task id is its Job id and the durable record lives at `j/<id>`.

Delegating:
- Give each worker self-contained instructions: task, paths/data, constraints, and expected output.
- For large or exact results, arrange a path-based handoff and tell dependants where to read it.
- Confirm dependencies before starting their consumers. Independent tasks may fan out; retain each Job id and collect every result.
- Reuse sessionId only when the task should join that conversation and its loaded context.

Receiving:
- Outstanding tasks appear as `[Tasks assigned to you]` together with terminal completion and failure controls. The completion result is the only channel back to the requester; ordinary chat text is not the task result. Complete once with the real answer, or fail with a useful error when work cannot be completed. Never leave a caller waiting on work you have abandoned.

Managing:
- Debug by reading the Job/timeline instead of re-running potentially mutating work.
